projects.name: Vault
projects.description: Full-stack Next.js (App Router) platform for saving and organizing content from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook, with OpenGraph link scraping and AI-generated summaries/tags via OpenAI GPT-4o-mini.
features: OpenGraph link scraping across major social platforms
AI-generated summaries and tags via OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL schema and auth layer
NextAuth email/magic-link authentication
5-phase, 32-sprint delivery plan

projects.name: VideoPlatform App
projects.description: YouTube-style video platform (MERN) with JWT access/refresh auth, Cloudinary storage, and Redis caching across 7 models and 9 REST controllers, deployed live via Docker Compose.
features: JWT access/refresh token authentication
Cloudinary media storage
Redis caching across 7 models and 9 REST controllers
RTK Query state with automatic 401 token refresh
Vitest/Supertest unit and integration test suites
Live deployment via Docker Compose

projects.name: MomoryBox
projects.description: Full-stack MERN e-commerce platform for personalized gift bundles with a guided multi-step checkout and a secondary bookable Experience Truck product line, integrating eSewa payments via custom HMAC-SHA256 verification.
features: Guided multi-step checkout for gift bundles
Bookable Experience Truck product line
eSewa payments with custom HMAC-SHA256 verification
70+ REST endpoints across 11 routers
JWT refresh-token rotation and RBAC (user/vendor/admin)
BullMQ + Redis queues for async payment verification
Playwright E2E and Vitest testing

projects.name: PMT Frontend
projects.description: Frontend for a 6-role project management SaaS platform (Client, PM, OM/CEO, Employee, Accounts, SuperAdmin) spanning ~130 routes, 114 components, and 24 Redux slices.
features: 6 user roles across ~130 routes and 114 components
24 Redux slices for state management
Cookie-based JWT auth with silent token refresh
CSRF protection and granular role/permission guards
Dynamic custom roles and permission presets

projects.name: TrelloMCP
projects.type: Model Context Protocol Server for Trello
projects.description: MCP server exposing Trello as 4 callable tools (get_boards, get_cards, create_card, move_card) for AI assistants like Claude Desktop, using the official MCP SDK over stdio transport with Zod-validated schemas.
features: 4 callable Trello tools for AI assistants
Official MCP SDK over stdio transport
Zod-validated schemas
Trello-to-DOCX reporting pipeline via Python
